claim_text: Established a policy-gated agent execution surface for governed enterprise AI workflows through deterministic route-policy dispatch, GraphRAG context-pack grounding, and human override escalation paths.
Advanced enterprise AI platform adoption through CFO-aligned adoption motions, connecting reusable workflow capabilities with customer value realization and usage-based forecasting.
Strengthened production trust with audit-grade runtime observability coverage for regulated AI workflows, supported by evaluation gates, telemetry, and rollback controls.
Standardized the AI solution lifecycle with a production-readiness gate set, using managed workflow orchestration and replayable runtime design to move deployments from intake through monitoring.
Built high-availability distributed service patterns for enterprise AI platforms across AWS, Databricks Lakehouse, vector services, and parallel decision workflows.
Scaled the engineering team from 8 to 28 while commercializing reusable AI platform capability through agentic platform productization and a repeatable operating model.
